name: Do you like sweets?
source:
There was a Crooked Man, who wore a crooked smile, with a mouth of crooked teeth, which he could never file. He conjures Crooked magic, for those with brains and nous.  But only if you meet him inside his Crooked House.'

That's part of the urban legend you've heard. You've been researching about encounters with 'the Crooked Man' for months. But now, you can find out if he really exists. Some reports say he's a wizard, others say he's...something entirely different.

[from [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/do-you-like-sweets]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“有一个歪嘴人，笑容歪歪扭扭，嘴里的牙齿歪歪扭扭，永远锉不齐。他为那些有头脑和理智的人施展弯曲魔法。但前提是你要在他的歪屋里见到他。”

这是你听过的都市传说的一部分。几个月来你一直在研究与“弯曲的人”的遭遇。但现在，你可以知道他是否真的存在。一些报道说他是一个巫师，另一些报道则说他是……完全不同的人。

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/do-you-like-sweets]itch.io[/url]]
